head: Turn burst photos into video with BurstReel on iPhone and Mac
dek: BurstReel makes a short video out of a burst of photos, with a pace you set from 1 to 60 photos a second. It was #92 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 19 November.
details: It imports a whole burst from Apple Photos in the order it was taken, and you can reorder, remove or reverse frames, make a back-and-forth loop and smooth camera shake. Videos come out at 1080p in portrait, square or landscape, without sound, and carry a BurstReel watermark. Everything is made on the device, with no account needed. One $4.99 purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Mac; it is made by Kazobe LLC and came out on 1 October.
where: iPhone, iPad and Mac, App Store, $4.99
means: If your phone is full of burst shots you never look at, this turns them into clips you can share.
todo: Find BurstReel in the App Store.
